arguments.code:
access_token=spotify_token
playlist_id=143
res=apis.spotify.show_playlist(playlist_id=playlist_id, access_token=access_token)
print(res)
print('songs_count', len(res.get('songs',[])))

access_token=spotify_token
song_ids=[42,121,165,180,189,212,224,251,283,300]
info=[]
for sid in song_ids:
    res=apis.spotify.show_song(song_id=sid)
    print('song_id',sid,'res',res)
    info.append(res)
# compute max by play_count
max_song=max(info, key=lambda x: x.get('play_count',0))
print('max_song', max_song['song_id'], max_song['title'], max_song.get('play_count'))
# also print sorted
sorted_info=sorted(info, key=lambda x: x.get('play_count',0), reverse=True)
print('sorted by play_count:')
for x in sorted_info:
    print(x['song_id'], x['title'], x.get('play_count'))

# Play the most-listened-to song (highest play_count) from the specified playlist
